An eccentric '''admiral''' had,<ref name="TOR" /> by [[3637 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|3.0}} As the Crew Skill mission "Gold = Good " was released with the ''Shadow of Revan'' expansion, it must therefore take place around that [[Standard year/Legends|year]] as well.</ref> hinted that he wished to acquire a [[Garblaque's astromech droid|gold-plated astromech droid]] owned by [[Garblaque]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]].<ref name="TOR" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
In that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], an individual associated with one of the sides in the ongoing [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] became aware that the [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]] had indicated that he desired to have the [[Droid/Legends|droid]]. They had a companion of theirs retrieve it for him.<ref name="TOR" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The admiral was mentioned in the Crew Skill mission "Gold = Good" released as part of the [[2014]] [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan|''Shadow of Revan'']] expansion to the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
